faqs.question: What is PrestaShop development?
faqs.answer: PrestaShop development involves designing, customizing, and optimizing online stores using the PrestaShop eCommerce platform. It covers everything from theme customization to plugin development and third-party integrations.

faqs.question: Why should I choose PrestaShop for my online store?
faqs.answer: PrestaShop is an open-source, highly customizable eCommerce platform offering multi-language and multi-currency capabilities, lightweight performance, and comprehensive inventory management without high licensing fees.

faqs.question: Can you customize our existing PrestaShop store design?
faqs.answer: Yes! We create custom themes, refine existing layouts, and enhance mobile responsiveness to provide an engaging, high-converting shopping experience.

faqs.question: Do you develop custom PrestaShop modules?
faqs.answer: Yes, our certified developers build custom modules according to official PrestaShop architecture guidelines to add bespoke business logic and integrations.

faqs.question: Can you integrate third-party payment gateways and shipping APIs?
faqs.answer: Yes, we integrate all major payment processors (Stripe, PayPal, Mollie) and shipping carriers (DHL, UPS, FedEx) seamlessly into your PrestaShop checkout.
